bio: Djailany van de Laarschot’s ambition is clear: to celebrate life à la française, and to bring his vision to life he has transformed a former estaminet into this charming, ever-buzzing bistro. The extensive menu embraces French culinary tradition – think foie gras pâté with brioche to start, followed by juicy rotisserie poussin and, finally, an indulgent crêpe Suzette. Traditional flavours are served up with abundant generosity in a heartwarming feast for any foodie....
